title.narrative: Promoting the Use of Artificial Intelligence to Accelerate Progress Towards Achieving SDG 4 in Pakistan

description.narrative: The project aims to promote the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to accelerate progress towards achieving SDG 4 (Quality Education), aligning with UNESCO’s 42 C/5 Output by leveraging emerging technologies to enhance educational access, analyze learning patterns, and optimize learning processes. Performance indicators include training 40-50 policymakers and educators on AI in education, establishing 5 strategic partnerships, and developing AI-driven policy recommendations. Baselines will assess the current use of AI in education in Pakistan, with targets for increased adoption and impact of AI technologies. This initiative aims to overcome barriers to education, including limited access and low quality of learning outcomes, by providing personalized learning experiences and data-driven insights. Direct beneficiaries include education policymakers, educators, and students. Key partners include government education departments, technology companies, NGOs, and academic institutions. The project contributes to SDG 4 by improving educational outcomes and accessibility, fostering innovation, and aligning with the 2030 Asia-Pacific Education Framework. Key activities include developing and delivering training modules, facilitating workshops and policy consultations, establishing partnerships, and monitoring the impact of AI solutions. Risk mitigation strategies involve comprehensive training, seeking additional resources, and addressing ethical concerns. The project promotes environmental sustainability through digital resources and eco-friendly practices, with strategies to ensure the sustainability of AI initiatives in education.
